title: action mic.grab: data
description: Take a mic slot in scope.room. hold=true keeps it (reclaiming after a timeout). force=true may bump another holder where the platform allows it (Camfrog: blocks the longest holder; modules must gate this behind a permission).

lane.description: (1.1) The grab carries a hub speaker's live audio (a mic lane), not the bot's own audio; interim results report phase, position and eta_ms.
